headword: ニュース{速報|そくほう}

definitions.gloss: breaking news; news flash; news bulletin
definitions.explanation: An urgent news report broadcast immediately when an important event occurs, interrupting regular programming or appearing as an alert.

examples.japanese: ニュース{速報|そくほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: A breaking news report just came in.

examples.japanese: ⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ニュース{速報|そくほう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{通知|つうち}→通知：04061_tsuuchi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: A breaking news notification arrived on my smartphone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ニュース{速報|そくほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流|なが}れた→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧⟦{途端|とたん}→途端：03462_totan⟧、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}ろう→取る：00565_toru⟧とした⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つながらなかった。
examples.english: The moment the earthquake breaking news aired, I tried to contact my family but couldn't get through on the phone.

notes:
A compound of ⟦ニュース→ニュース：04437_nyuusu⟧ (news) and ⟦{速報|そくほう}→速報：14319_sokuhou⟧ (bulletin, flash report). In Japan, ニュース{速報|そくほう} typically appears as a text banner across the top or bottom of the TV screen, accompanied by a distinctive chime sound. It is used for earthquakes, major political events, severe weather warnings, and other urgent developments.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ニュース{速報|そくほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: a news flash comes in
- ニュース{速報|そくほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流|なが}れる→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧: a news flash airs/runs
- ニュース{速報|そくほう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{通知|つうち}→通知：04061_tsuuchi⟧: breaking news notification
- ニュース{速報|そくほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive a news flash

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{速報|そくほう}→速報：14319_sokuhou⟧: bulletin; flash report — the general term for any urgent report, not limited to news
- ⟦{号外|ごうがい}→号外：19773_gougai⟧: newspaper extra — a special edition printed for breaking news
- ⟦{臨時|りんじ}ニュース→臨時ニュース：26663_rinjinyuusu⟧: special news bulletin — an extended broadcast interrupting regular programming
